svg.text: Print a block 118 x 38 x 15 with four 27 mm through pockets,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 4 mm screw holes, one at each end, 8 from the end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: screw it to the base in front of the bubbler (base

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: layout picture). The four 26 mm salt jars stand in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pockets on the plywood, with 0.5 mm clearance.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Label each pocket: LiCl, MgCl2, NaCl, KCl.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each jar drops in and lifts out freely.
